bounded_expansion.principle: Add coverage in small, pre-registered checkpoints. Every checkpoint must preserve exact area_id/depth/statistic joins, report per-AOI counts, and avoid any global or representative claim.

repository_context.d04_rule: All D04 records are evidence-only. No cross-body or same-quantity mapping is registered for hydrogen proxies, radar CPR, soil wetness or snow depth.

non_claims: This catalog is not a global or exhaustive survey.
No observation is fabricated, zero-filled, interpolated or transferred across bodies.
